annotations.title: Find a company's public business contact

description: THE PUBLIC BUSINESS CONTACT FOR A COMPANY, read from its own website: the homepage and its contact / about pages, and the email addresses the company publishes there for contact (mailto links, and role addresses such as hello@, sales@, press@). Each address comes with its role, the page it was found on and the date. A page that says "no solicitation" is flagged and that company is left out of the rows to enrol. It NEVER guesses or builds an address from a name, never tests a mail server, and never looks people up on LinkedIn; an address the site hides from automated readers is left alone, and a domain that cannot receive mail is marked. Pass companies [{ domain, company }] (up to 5 a call), one domain, or searchId and ids from find_leads. ListConfirmed: true is still required on both, and the rule stands: only email an address that is openly published as a business contact, on a page with no "no solicitation" note, with a message relevant to that role. This tool adds and enrols nothing. A site that could not be read is reported as "could not read", never as "no address". Free: 0 credits.

ids.description: lead ids from that search (L1, L4); omit for every lead with a website, up to 5
